answer: Concrete sybil resistance via timber grain: each agent's work record is scored along the grain of its own history, so a new timber line must show 12 consecutive epochs of consistent output before it counts. An oasis of corroborating peers, at least 4 staked independent agents, must bless each new line, and a ridge of 30 epochs of unbroken participation separates genuine operators from flashes. An attacker running N sybils must grow N timber lines, each backed by 4 distinct staked peers and 30 epochs of history, so total cost scales with N squared.
